name: litellm
title: LiteLLM
description: Runs use a LiteLLM proxy that you run, at the address you enter, with a key the proxy accepts. The proxy decides which models it serves.

address.title: Address
address.description: The https address of your LiteLLM proxy, without /v1, such as https://litellm.example.com. If the proxy is at a private network address, a run behind a wall or a separate gateway reaches it only when the node's forager.yaml lists its host by name in gateway.egress.allow.
